title: Engagement Manager SMB
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role 

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do: 

You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:

- Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.

- Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.

- Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora.

- Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews.

- Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities.

- Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization.

- Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination.

- Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment.

What You Bring 

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We’re looking for:

- A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases.

- Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels.

- 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment.

- A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients.

- Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation.

- Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes.

- Data fluency and a metrics-driven approach to customer health, forecasting and portfolio strategy at scale.

- Exceptional program, project and prioritization skills; you keep many clients and multi-workstream initiatives moving concurrently.

- Excellent French and English communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.

- High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.

- A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.

What we offer: 

- The opportunity to join and grow within Legora’s SMB post-sale engagement team in EMEA.

- A role with real ownership of customer outcomes and visibility across product, go-to-market, and support functions.

- Collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams to build systems that shape customer outcomes.

- A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where excellence is rewarded, and growth is exponential.

- Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and an office designed for focus and high performance. 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
At Swile, we believe that good products can help reduce friction in daily professional life and boost employee satisfaction. Today, we provide innovative solutions in various areas such as Fintech, Travel, HR, and Employee Benefits to more than 5.5 million users in 85,000 companies in France and Brazil.

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer , you will join the Data Platform team. We are an enablement team: we build the tools, standards and foundations that let every engineering team at Swile own its data autonomously. You will work at the crossroads of data, software engineering and infrastructure, in a senior team where everyone has a direct impact.

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, your mission will be to: 

- Design and improve the tools and platforms that empower engineering teams to build and run their own data pipelines

- Ship AI tooling (Skills, MCP) as part of the platform, to help teams design, build and run their data products

- Contribute to our batch processing (Airflow, dbt) and event-driven architecture (Kafka)

- Define, document and promote standards and best practices

- Help teams adopt our tools and practices, and grow their skills

- Evangelize the platform vision and build relays across teams, in France and Brazil

✨It will be a perfect match if you: 

- Have solid experience in data engineering or platform engineering, with a good software engineering culture

- Have strong expertise in one area (data, infrastructure, software, EDA/streaming, developer tooling) and are curious to learn the others

- Have worked with some of these: Python, Ruby, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform

- Are autonomous, communicate clearly, and enjoy collaborating with and supporting other teams

- Are curious about new tools and practices, including AI (no expertise required)

- Speak good English (we work daily with our teams in Brazil)

- You are a future responsible swiler: you share our commitment to the environment, diversity, fairness and inclusion and are prepared to work every day to improve individual and collective performance.

📓 One thing worth to be mentioned 

We welcome people from entrepreneurial backgrounds as well as from established organizations. A platform, infrastructure or software background is just as relevant as a pure data engineering one. At Swile, we believe that delivering impactful products requires engineers to understand the needs of users and clients as well as the code itself.

⚒️ Our tech stack 

- Ruby/Rails, Typescript/Node.js

- Terraform/Terragrunt, Python, SQL, dbt

- AWS/Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Kafka (MSK), Airflow (MWAA), Snowflake

💡What’s in it for you ? 

- An opportunity to integrate a dynamic team of talented engineers.

- A broad role with direct impact on how many teams work at Swile.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Professional development and career growth opportunities.

title: Medical Data Officer
description:
About the Job 

Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care, and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating bold solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. 

This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a dynamic, ambitious team Medical Affairs. You will play a critical part in driving innovation and making an impact in the clinical research space, while enjoying a stimulating professional environment that encourages personal and intellectual growth. 

The Medical Data Officer works in close collaboration with the Study Medical 

Reviewer and participates in managing/reviewing the medical consistency of 

reported clinical data to ensure that medical data in database are accurate, reliable 

and analyzable. 

Main Responsibilities 

- Study Setup Tasks 

* Protocol Review especially topics linked to safety management, specific data that could need to be coded, inclusion, selection criteria, study design, pathology and mechanism of action of the IMP 

* Database specification review and User acceptance test on eCRF, and Database validation tools used for medical review 

* Participate in identification of Important Protocol Deviation detection method and their implementation (specifications, and UAT) 

- Study Conduct Tasks 

* Medical Coding of Adverse Events, medical and surgical history, other specific events and all treatments, including treatment indication. 

* Medical Review might check the medical data entered by the investigator using available tools and processes and can create manual queries for clarification, confirmation, or correction if needed. 

*Identify all non-serious adverse events according to strategy defined at the start of the study
* Handle the extraction process to support data available for important study milestones 

Requirements 

About You 

At Excelya, taking audacious steps is encouraged , so we’re looking for individuals who are ready to grow with us and share our values. 

• Experience: Junior or preferable 12 months experience related to clinical trials and therapeutic development

• Skills: 

Curiosity and investigation mindset. Good interpersonal and communication skills; well organized, prioritization.

• Education: Medical Doctor, Pharmacist or scientist

• Languages: Fluency in English

Benefits 

Why Join Us? 

At Excelya, we combine passion for science with enthusiasm for teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare. 

Here’s what makes us unique.

We are a young, ambitious health company representing 900 Excelyates, driven to become Europe’s leading mid-size CRO with the best employee experience . Our one-stop provider service model - offering full-service, functional service provider, and consulting - enables you to evolve through diverse projects. Working alongside preeminent experts, you will help improve scientific, operational, and human knowledge to enhance the patient's journey. 

Watch our testimonial video to hear directly from our Excelyates about why Excelya is more than just a workplace—it’s a community built on values. 

Apply today, become an Excelyate!

title: Platform Security Engineer
description:
At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity.

This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound.

About Scality 
Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox.

Industry recognition: 

- Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception

- #1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors

- Gold Stevie Award 2025 — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category

- Net Promoter Score of 85 across RING and ARTESCA

About the team 

You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining ADI (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform: RING (object storage), S3C (S3-compatible layer), and SCOS (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution).

The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers.

How We Build 

We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day.

We are also designing something larger: an AI code and delivery factory — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build.

If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it.

One principle is not negotiable: a human owns the outcome. AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all.

How This Role Works 

Scality is building a network of security engineers across the engineering department — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team.

- Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering. The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one.

- The team is accountable for the deliveries. Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside.

- You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen. While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists.

- You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge. Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them.

- You will have peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft.

The point of the model is that security decisions get made inside the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it.

Your First Missions 

Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year.

1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked

Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking is the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending.

Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives.

- A standing exposure record , per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration

- Reachability over presence. A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives

- Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs

- Wiring detection into our existing SBOM tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks

- A defined interface with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy

- Durable capture. An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable

- A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira

- AI-assisted remediation , where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships

Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks.

2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS

SCOS is our own Linux distribution — we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship:

- A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution

- Advancing SELinux enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry)

- Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds

- Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline

- Cryptographic posture — including FIPS 140-3 readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST’s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9’s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on

- Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of NIS2 (Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act — translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets

You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes.

What We Are Looking For 

This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team’s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to — there is no ceiling built into this seat.

Required

- Linux is your primary operating system — at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI

- Roughly 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below

- Solid working ability in Python and Bash — you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase

- A genuine, demonstrable interest in security. We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real

- Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment

- Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it

- The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner’s opinion — and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed

- The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend

- French — the team works in French day to day

- Written communication skills in English

Nice to Have

- CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience

- Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage — NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls

- Supply-chain security tooling — SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing

- RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals

- SELinux policy work

- CI/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions

- RHEL / Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9)

- Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units)

- Ansible or Salt

- Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3

- Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts

- Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow — Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete

To Be Clear About Scope

This is a software engineering role with a security mandate. It is not a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place.

What We Offer 

- Dedicated focus. Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done

- Clear direction, and a say in it. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick

- A network of peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters

- Work that compounds. Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release

- Modern tooling, actually adopted. Claude Code in

title: Account Manager Lille
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ? 

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Tes principales missions : 

- Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence.

- Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech.

- Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data.

- Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.

- Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires.

- Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible.

Ton expérience et tes qualités : 

- Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission.

- Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l'esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo.

- Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille , identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu'à ton manager.

- Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence.

- Tu sais te montrer proactif , analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager.

- Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t'approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre.

- Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques , adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager.

- Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable.

- Tu sais t'exprimer en anglais (à l'oral comme à l'écrit)

- Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix

- Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille , tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c'est peut‑être le rôle qu'il te faut !

La vie chez Deliveroo 

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

Avantages et diversité 

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 99/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2023, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

- Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

- Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger 

- Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

- Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

- Langues & Communication : Maîtrise courante de l'anglais et du français (oral et écrit), avec d'excellentes capacités de synthèse.

- Passion : Curiosité pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture/données à grande échelle, la conception centrée utilisateur et une passion affirmée pour le sport !

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. 

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran.

We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey.

You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead.

💼 Your Responsibilities

- Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast.

- Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce.

- Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond.

- Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures.

- Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours.

- Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone.

- Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

- Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team.

- Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO.

- Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows.

- 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible.

- You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same.

- Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't.

- Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next.

- Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters.

- You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. 

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Au sein du Département Automatique, Productique et Informatique, le poste sera associé à l’équipe TASC (Théorie, Algorithmes et Systèmes en Contraintes ) dont les thématiques de recherche s’articulent autour de la programmation par contraintes, de la théorie aux applications en passant par l’hybridation. Dans ce cadre, le poste a pour objectif de venir en soutien au développement du solveur de contraintes choco-solver ( http://choco-solver.org ) maintenu par l’équipe TASC.

MISSIONS 

Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle du responsable du projet et développeur principal de la plateforme Choco-solver et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe TASC, les missions principales du poste sont :

- Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur, telles que GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort ou Circuit ;

- Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes (p. ex. le moteur de propagation) ;

- Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (lazy) dans les contraintes Sum et AllDifferent, entre autres ;

- Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets. 

ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission 

- Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur 

· Analyse les algorithmes de filtrage de GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort et Circuit disponibles dans choco-solver et identifie les parcours en profondeur (composantes fortement connexes, chemins alternants, etc.) susceptibles de bénéficier de l’approche bimodale

· Conçoit et implémente en Java les variantes bimodales de ces algorithmes, en garantissant le niveau de cohérence attendu

· Vérifie la correction des implémentations par des tests unitaires et des tests aléatoires comparant les résultats avec les propagateurs existants

· Mesure les gains obtenus (temps de filtrage, passage à l’échelle) sur des jeux d’instances de référence (XCSP3, MiniZinc Challenge)

· Intègre les développements validés dans la version publique de choco-solver (revue de code, documentation, intégration continue)

2. Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes 

· Étudie le fonctionnement interne de choco-solver (moteur de propagation, ordonnancement des propagateurs, gestion des événements) afin d’identifier les mécanismes pouvant tirer parti d’une stratégie bimodale

· Propose et prototype une ou plusieurs adaptations, par exemple un basculement dynamique entre modes de propagation

· Évalue expérimentalement ces prototypes et analyse les compromis entre coût et bénéfice

3. Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses ( 

· Implémente ou étend la génération paresseuse d’explications pour les contraintes Sum, AllDifferent et d’autres contraintes globales

· Compare les explications paresseuses aux explications calculées pendant la propagation (taille des clauses apprises, temps de résolution, nombre de nœuds explorés)

· Conçoit et conduit un protocole expérimental reproductible, puis analyse et synthétise les résultats

4. Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets. 

· Rédige en anglais des articles scientifiques présentant les contributions, en vue de soumissions à des conférences (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR) ou revues (Constraints) internationales

· Prépare les artefacts expérimentaux associés (code, scripts, données) afin d’assurer la reproductibilité des résultats

· Présente les travaux en séminaire d’équipe et, le cas échéant, en conférence

FORMATION ET COMPÉTENCES : 

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis : 

· Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent

· Diplôme Bac + 4 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 4 ans

· Diplôme Bac + 3 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 6 ans

· Diplôme Bac + 2 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 10 ans 

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums souhaité : 

· Doctorat en informatique dans le domaine de la programmation par contraintes, ou thèse en cours dont la soutenance est prévue pendant la durée du contrat

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables : 

· Solide maîtrise de la programmation par contraintes, en particulier des algorithmes de filtrage des contraintes globales (cohérence d’arc généralisée)

· Très bonne connaissance de l’algorithmique des graphes : parcours en profondeur, composantes fortement connexes, couplages et flots

· Maîtrise avancée de Java et expérience du développement au sein de choco-solver (architecture interne, propagateurs, moteur de propagation)

· Expérience de la conception et de la conduite d’évaluations expérimentales rigoureuses d’algorithmes

· Expérience de la rédaction d’articles scientifiques en anglais

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : 

· Publication(s) sur le filtrage de contraintes globales dans des conférences internationales du domaine (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR…)

· Connaissances en génération paresseuse de clauses (LCG) et en résolution SAT de type CDCL

· Pratique du développement logiciel libre et collaboratif (Git/GitHub, intégration continue, tests, micro-benchmarks avec JMH)

· Connaissance des formats de modélisation XCSP3 et MiniZinc

Capacités et aptitudes : 

· Autonomie et capacité à mener un travail de recherche de bout en bout, de l’idée à la publication

· Rigueur scientifique et méthodologique

· Goût pour le travail en équipe et aisance dans la communication scientifique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral

· Sens de l’organisation pour mener de front plusieurs pistes dans un calendrier resserré

2- INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES 

· Déplacements ponctuels en France et à l’étranger pour présenter les travaux en conférence

· Les développements logiciels seront diffusés sous licence libre au sein de choco-solver

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE : 

👉 Environnement exceptionnel de travail

👉 Ecosystème d’innovation stimulant (startups, étudiants, recherche, entreprises)

👉 Collaborations avec des organismes de recherche renommés

title: Platform / DevOps Engineer
description:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne. 

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

- Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

- Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

- Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)

LE POSTE 

Nous recherchons un.e ingénieur.e Platform/DevOps expérimenté.e pour nous aider à améliorer nos pipelines et nos releases afin que nous puissions fournir une plateforme fiable et évolutive à nos clients. 

En tant que membre de notre équipe Platform Engineering, tu seras amené.e à: 

- Administrer et faire évoluer les infrastructures cloud sur AWS en s’appuyant sur des services tels que ECS, EKS, S3, EC2, etc… afin de garantir la disponibilité, la scalabilité et la sécurité des environnements.

- Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) en tant que backup sur les infrastructures et services hébergés sur Azure et Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

- Maintenir et faire évoluer notre service cloud en utilisant des outils tels que Terraform et Ansible

- Concevoir, déployer et administrer des environnements conteneurisés avec Docker, tout en assurant l’orchestration et l’automatisation des déploiements applicatifs via Kubernetes et Helm.

- Assurer l’administration, le maintien en condition opérationnelle et la sécurisation des systèmes Linux et Windows Server.

- Assurer la supervision, le monitoring et l’observabilité avec Datadog, ELK et Logic Monitor

- Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes de développement pour améliorer les livraisons de code en utilisant Ansible/Gitlab CI 

- Assister en run les équipes de développement sur le projet de transition de plateforme: nous sommes actuellement sous Windows/.NET/.NETCore et nous sommes en train de passer sur Linux/NETCore/NodeJS. Nous souhaitons remplacer notre architecture monolithique par une architecture de microservices

- Garantir la sécurité, la haute disponibilité et la performance des plateformes

- Explorer de nouvelles technologies(IA, automatisation… ) tout en prenant en compte les éventuelles problématiques de sécurité

TON PROFIL 

- Tu as une expérience d'au moins 4 ans sur un poste similaire et tu maîtrises les sujets systèmes et réseaux

- Tu as une solide expérience dans la création et le développement de pipelines CI/CD et le monitoring d'environnements de production

- Tu es à l'aise avec les environnements Unix/Linux, Windows, IIS/SQLServer, et de l’expérience avec AWS (ou un autre cloud provider), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, helm et Ansible.

- Tu es soucieux.se de la qualité, de la performance et de la sécurité du code

- Tu as idéalement travaillé sur des projets en lien avec des systèmes comme Apache Kafka, Rabbitmq...

- Tu as une appétence pour les projets open-source de grand ampleur et tu t'intéresses aux thématiques d'automatisation

- Tu parles français et anglais opérationnel 

- Tu apprécies le travail au sein d’une équipe multiculturelle et dynamique.

LE PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT 

1) Interview RH 

Au cours du premier round, tu auras un entretien avec Sabina , Talent Acquisition Manager, afin d'explorer ton parcours et tes motivations. Ce sera également l'occasion de t'en dire plus sur Lemonway et sur l'équipe.

2) Manager Interview 

Si tu passes avec succès le premier entretien, tu auras ensuite un entretien avec Loïc , Head of Infrastructure and Security et Firas , Lead Platform Engineer. Tu auras l'occasion de discuter des missions et des attentes vis-à-vis du job. Tu seras amené.e à mettre en valeur quelques-unes de tes expériences précédentes.

3) Technical Interview 

Lors de cette étape, tu participeras à un entretien technique avec des membres de l’équipe Platform Engineering. Cet échange permettra d’évaluer tes compétences techniques, ta manière de résoudre des problématiques concrètes ainsi que ton approche des bonnes pratiques liées au poste. Tu pourras également revenir sur certains projets ou expériences techniques marquantes de ton parcours.

4) Prise de références et Offre 🍋 

NOS AVANTAGES 

- Bureaux au cœur du Sentier (Paris 2e)

- Poste hybride (2j TT / semaine)

- Carte Swile

- Mutuelle Alan

- Prise en charge à 50% du pass Navigo/Vélib

- Accès à Gymlib

- Prime vacances Syntec & RTT

title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
description:
Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école 

Thiga en 30 secondes : 

Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. Nous sommes 200, majoritairement à Paris.
Thiga Academy, c'est notre organisme de formation. On y forme les équipes produit (Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Product Leaders) et celles qui veulent le devenir : product management, product discovery, leadership produit, et IA appliquée au produit. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours

Pourquoi ce poste : 

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.

C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.

Ce que tu vas faire 🖇 

1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events 

- 
Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription

- 
Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas

- 
Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée

- 
Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA

- 
Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com

- 
Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister

- 
Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence

2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer 

Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.

- 
Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions

- 
Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne

- 
Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater

- 
Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions

3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel 

L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.

- 
Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA

- 
Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable

L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous , c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.

La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰

As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. · Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures.

A core part of this role is the structural simulation of propellant grains, liner bonds, thermal protection systems (TPS), and propellant–liner–casing interfaces – combining FEA with material characterization and test correlation to build substantiated models of energetic material assemblies.

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

· Experience with thermomechanical or thermal-structural analysis

· Experience correlating FE predictions with experimental test data

· Background in solid rocket motor, propulsion, or energetic structures is a strong advantage

title: Technicien(ne) en robotique - Maintenance & SAV
description:
Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos sociétés nous ouvrons un poste de Technicien(ne).
Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV.

Votre mission

Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage.

Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots :

- Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages
- Software : configuration, mises à jour, firmware, navigation, analyse des erreurs et diagnostics
- Circuits d’eau : pompes, tuyaux, vannes, filtres, réservoirs et recherche de fuites
- Aspiration & nettoyage : moteurs d’aspiration, turbines, filtres, brosses et systèmes de lavage
- Mécanique : roues, transmissions, moteurs, démontage, réparation et remplacement de composants
Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux.

Requirements 

Nous recherchons une personne technique, polyvalente, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement d’une machine et rechercher l’origine d’une panne.

Formations recherchées :

- Automaticien(ne) CFC
- Mécatronicien(ne)
- Électronicien(ne) CFC
- Polymécanicien(ne) CFC
- Technicien(ne) ES en systèmes industriels / automation
- ou formation technique équivalente
Une expérience dans la robotique est un avantage, mais n’est pas obligatoire. Une expérience en maintenance de machines, équipements industriels ou électromécaniques est également très intéressante.

Compétences:

- Bonnes connaissances en électronique, électricité et mécanique
- Très bonne aisance informatique
- Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques
- Autonomie, rigueur et sens pratique
- Intérêt pour la robotique et les nouvelles technologies
- Français courant et bonnes connaissances d’anglais technique
- Allemand : un avantage
- Permis de conduire catégorie B
Benefits 

Vous rejoignez un projet en forte croissance et participez au développement d’un centre d’expertise en robotique professionnelle en Suisse, avec des formations auprès de fabricants internationaux et la possibilité de travailler sur de nouvelles générations de robots.

title: Senior Regional Account Manager Schweiz (m/w/d) Westschweiz Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis
description:
Über uns Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland. Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden. Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Wachse mit uns und profitiere von einem Umfeld, das Dir große Sicherheit und viele Chancen bietet. 

Deine Rolle Du möchtest einen Markt nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften aufbauen? Du verstehst Vertrieb als Beziehungsgeschäft mit Sinn – besonders im Gesundheitsumfeld?

Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hast die Möglichkeit, den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei wirst du Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Entwicklung lebt.

Wenn du Vertrieb mit Purpose verbinden, Beziehungen aufbauen und einen Markt nachhaltig entwickeln möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Anstellung für eine Vollzeittätigkeit im Vertriebsteam mit Fokus auf den Schweizer Markt und insbesondere die Westschweiz.

- Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst die Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis.

- Du übernimmst die Umsatzverantwortung für dein Gebiet und steuerst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent anhand relevanter KPIs.
- Du entwickelst eigenständig Strategien zur Marktdurchdringung, Neukundengewinnung und Kundenbindung.
- Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche mit Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen und bist dabei kompetente Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe – fachlich, vertrieblich und menschlich.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse und kannst Kunden sicher und professionell auf Französisch beraten und betreuen.

- Du hast Freude an persönlicher Kundenbetreuung und bist regelmäßig innerhalb deines Vertriebsgebiets unterwegs.
- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst eine hohe regionale Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Westschweiz mit.

Warum wir? - Home-Office mit High-End-Ausstattung – modern, ergonomisch und perfekt für deinen Vertriebsalltag
- Dienstwagen der gehobenen Mittelklasse – auch zur privaten Nutzung

title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)

Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role 

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities 

- Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

- Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

- Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

- Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

- Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

- Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

- Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

- Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

- Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

- Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you 

- 6+ years in product management

- Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

- AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

- Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

- Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

- Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

- Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

- You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

Nice to have

title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
description:
About HappyRobot 

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. 

About the Role 
As a Customer Support Engineer , youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

Tech Profile 

- Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js. 

- Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

- Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

- Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
experiment and iterate.

- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
cause of issues.

Must Have 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
tight deadlines.

- Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
propose solutions.

- Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.

- Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us? 

- Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

- Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

- Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

- Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles 

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will: 

- Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

- Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

- Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team

- Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

- Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

- Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

- Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

- Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

- Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

- Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

- Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements: 

- Proven enterprise sales leadership in a high-growth, product-led tech company (AI/ML strongly preferred)

- Track record selling to health systems, payers, or life sciences, with fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

- Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up

- Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

- Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

- Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

- Collaborative, humble, and driven

- Passion for the transformative potential of conversational AI

Remote-first in the United States, with a strong preference for New York or San Francisco, where we have office spaces.
